[[Favor of the Lord of Blades]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Favor of the Lord of Blades]]:''' As you hold this spear in your hands, a steely voice echoes in your mind...
My faithful child of the Creation Forge, you may wield this spear as if it were your own. With this weapon, I grant you my blessing.
(This item counts as a [[Favored weapon]].)
